style: 3D animated satire, deadpan slapstick; penguin fills two thirds of frame height

subject.character: ONE neat emperor penguin accountant, black tailcoat, bow tie, orange beak; same face throughout, fully serious

props.kit: round glass cupping jars; hand gas burner, blue flame; four cotton wicks taped on the penguin's back
props.leaflets: white leaflets printed ДЕКЛАРАЦИЯ in black Cyrillic capitals

environment: small ice floe, dense pressure ridges with icicles, deep blue water
lighting: low polar sun behind-left, gold glints; cold blue sky glow behind-right; flares on every move

light_events.event: rotor shadows strobe across the floe

motion_rule: camera orbits, new shot size every beat, never parked; both act every beat

audio.delivery: flat low brisk male voice, native, no accent
audio.pacing: brisk, each line once in its beat, no pause after Я; after 4.75 rotor roar, gasps, clinks, pops, no words

timeline.a: medium low, orbit left; the penguin belly-slides in along the ridge; the walrus clicks on the burner, jar bag on a tusk
waist shot, orbit right; he brakes with his flippers, springs up, waddles off; the walrus lumbers after, flame roaring
low medium, orbit left; he trips on flat ice, flops, belly-slides under the burner; the walrus sweeps it low over him, two wicks catch
medium, counter-arc; he springs off his belly, waddles round the walrus, flippers flapping; the walrus swivels, snatches a jar
waist shot, orbit to his side; he bolts, leaps a low ridge, lands sliding; the walrus belly-bounds after, swats a jar onto a lit wick mid-leap, pop
medium, arc; he drops to his belly and spins by the walrus; the walrus lunges, jar raised, misses
low medium, swift orbit; helicopter skids drop to top edge; he is knocked flat, belly-spins; the walrus slaps the second jar onto the other wick, pop
waist shot, arc, leaflets pour; one slaps his face, he spins, peels it off; one sticks to the walrus's tusks
waist shot, orbit; he reads it, eyes bulging, beak shut tight, staggers back two steps; the walrus jams the burner in his teeth, snatches two jars
medium, arc, his face to camera; he hops at each pop; the walrus belly-flops in, lights two wicks, slaps two jars on, pop, pop
medium, arc left; he scrambles off, flippers windmilling, jars clinking; the walrus bounds after, burner blazing
waist shot, arc right; he whips round, a back jar clanks the walrus's tusk; the walrus reels, jar bag bursts, jars roll
low medium, arc; he kicks a rolling jar, trips on flat ice again, waddles on; the walrus heaves up, snatches a leaflet, lunges

waist shot, short arc; he runs, flops and belly-glides in a curve, head raised, face turned to camera, four jars upright on his back, clinking, still gliding at the end; the walrus belly-flops after, bumps his tail, leaflet on a tusk

must_appear: 1.15 wicks catch; 2.65 jar on mid-leap; 4.75 skids, second jar; 5.45 ДЕКЛАРАЦИЯ; 6.70 jars pop, face to camera; 9.35 glide, face to camera, four jars
negative_prompt: static camera, aerial shot, locked-off shots, subtitles, watermark, jar labels, digits, duplicate penguins, two walruses, floating jars, hero seen only from behind, a jar held up to the lens, a repeated word, speech after 4.9, English speech, foreign accent, extra limbs, a jar on his beak, burnt feathers, penguin standing still, penguin waiting, walrus carefully placing
